mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% and nonfarm payrolls decline by more than 0.5% in the most recent month, it signals severe labor market deterioration triggering policy responses that produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8.0% and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for the trigger condition remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) combined with declining retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a shift toward housing-led recovery that signals improving consumer confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (HOUST rising and RSAFS falling) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a deep industrial contraction regime (INDPRO below 90 for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 rebounds as markets anticipate aggressive policy interventions, producing positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 90 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index below 212.0 signals deflationary pressure that prompts aggressive monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is below 212.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 8.0% combined with near-zero federal funds rate (<=0.25%) indicates severe recession with limited monetary policy space, triggering fiscal stimulus that produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (UNRATE>8.0% and FEDFUNDS<=0.25%) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth declines for two consecutive quarters (GDPC1), it signals recessionary conditions that prompt policy responses, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening housing demand that precedes broader economic recovery, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
